mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_notification_link_click (environment, access_token, notification_id, flow_execution_id, job_execution_id, actor_user_id, source, event_type, logged_in, event_at, client_ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{environment}, #{tokenHash}'', #{notificationId}, #{executionId}, #{jobExecutionId}, #{actorUserId}'', #{source}, #{eventType}, #{loggedIn}, #{eventAt}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent})
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE skill_flow_notification_link_click UPDATE actor_user_id = #{actorUserId}, event_type = 'LOGIN_VIEW', logged_in = 1, event_at = #{eventAt} WHERE environment = #{environment} AND access_token = #{accessToken} AND event_type = 'CLICK'
mapper.select: SELECT flow_execution_id, job_execution_id, CASE WHEN flow_execution_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'LONG_TASK' ELSE 'INDEPENDENT_TASK' END AS execution_type, actor_user_id, source, event_type, max(logged_in) AS logged_in, coalesce(nullIf(any(task_display_name), ''), concat('任务 #', toString(ifNull(job_execution_id, flow_execution_id)))) AS task_display_name, any(execution_at) AS execution_at, min(event_at) AS first_event_at, max(event_at) AS latest_event_at, count() AS event_count FROM skill_flow_notification_link_click WHERE (#{filters.environment} IS NULL OR environment = #{filters.environment}) AND (#{filters.executionId} IS NULL OR flow_execution_id = #{filters.executionId} OR job_execution_id = #{filters.executionId}) AND (#{filters.source} IS NULL OR #{filters.source} = '' OR source = #{filters.source}) AND (#{filters.eventType} IS NULL OR #{filters.eventType} = '' OR event_type = #{filters.eventType}) AND (#{filters.executionId} IS NULL OR flow_execution_id = #{filters.executionId} OR job_execution_id = #{filters.executionId}) AND (#{filters.from} IS NULL OR event_at >= #{filters.from}) AND (#{filters.to} IS NULL OR event_at < #{filters.to}) GROUP BY flow_execution_id, job_execution_id, actor_user_id, source, event_type ORDER BY latest_event_at DESC
